messages:
mike: Heads-up — onboarding sage-mini-v3 weights landed in GCS: gs://rw-models/onboard/sage-mini-v3/2026-03-10/weights.tar.gz. Can someone confirm tokenizer mapping and special token handling? I'm seeing an off-by-one when using chat template.

 eva: grabbing. what off-by-one? sample?

 mike: example prompt snippet — 'system: You are helpful\nuser: Hi' tokenized differently vs local HF tokenizer. In runtime we see an extra BOS token before system, which shifts indices when computing prefix cache.

 eva: hmm. did we use add_bos True in the model config? pinging @ryan.

 ryan: quick check — model config at gs://rw-models/onboard/sage-mini-v3/config.json shows "add_bos": false but our chatfmt layer adds it. That explains double-BOS.

 mike: ah. so fix options: a) set model.add_bos=true in config b) change chatfmt to not prepend BOS if model claims no BOS. Which preferred? ccing @carla (serving)

 carla: prefer updating chatfmt to respect model flag, safer for mixed models. small change. I'll open PR.

 carla: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/chatfmt/pull/128 — updates behavior and adds unit test for sentinel handling. Please review @eva @ryan

 eva: LGTM but add test for trailing newline -> tokenizer was trimming EOS in one case.

 ryan: noted. test added in PR. also added config validation script snippet for onboarding checks:

 ```
 python tools/validate_model.py --config gs://rw-models/onboard/sage-mini-v3/config.json --weights gs://rw-models/onboard/sage-mini-v3/weights.tar.gz
 ```

 mike: awesome. after merge can we run model smoke: run local container with quantized weights and run sample chat template and compare token counts to HF baseline? (would like to avoid shipping regression)

 carla: yes. I'll run smoke on dedicated infra tomorrow and post results here. :rocket:

 infra-bot: deploy scheduled — smoke-worker queue at 2026-03-11T09:00Z

 mike: thanks. last ask: add a quick note in onboarding checklist about verifying "bos/eos" and chatfmt compatibility + where to look for weights path. saved to onboarding doc.

 eva: added note: https://go.redwood/onboard-checklist#bos-eos

 mike: cool. closing this thread after smoke passes. :white_check_mark:
